subject.title: feat(channels): batch 2 producers drop media placeholder bodies

question: Should this cross-channel transcript and media-fact migration land after the contributor supplies redacted real ingress proof for the affected channel paths?
rationale: The protected maintainer label and intentional compatibility-visible rendering change require an explicit human merge decision after proof confirms the new behavior on real channel ingress.

options.title: Require live ingress proof
options.body: Hold merge until redacted Discord, Feishu, and Microsoft Teams evidence shows media-only messages keep an empty caption while preserving structured media facts and the intended unavailable-media result.

options.title: Accept automated-only evidence
options.body: Merge based on the focused suites and changed-surface checks while accepting that real channel delivery and transcript behavior has not been demonstrated.

options.title: Pause the migration
options.body: Defer this batch if maintainers do not want the remaining placeholder-rendering compatibility change in the current release window.

recommendation.title: Require live ingress proof
recommendation.body: Hold merge until redacted Discord, Feishu, and Microsoft Teams evidence shows media-only messages keep an empty caption while preserving structured media facts and the intended unavailable-media result.
